by.description: Who decided, for the audit line.
by.title: By

DemoSessionOut.description: A demo session: send ``token`` as ``Authorization: Bearer`` until ``expires_at``.
DemoSessionOut.title: DemoSessionOut

DemoStatus.description: A demo caller's session and today's spend against the caps (kobo).
DemoStatus.title: DemoStatus

EventIn.description: A system event from Go or the scheduler: a delivery done, a routine due.

event_id.description: The sender's own event id. The same id twice is one turn.
event_id.title: Event Id

name.description: Webhook kind (delivery_completed, bank_credit, ...) or routine name (stock.weekly_check, ...).
name.title: Name

received_at.description: When the message was received, with its zone. Defaults to now. A time without a zone is read as Africa/Lagos (WAT, UTC+1).
received_at.title: Received At

shop_id.description: The shop the event is about; empty for the distributor.
shop_id.title: Shop Id

EventIn.title: EventIn

Step.description:
One line of reasoning on the thread: a routing decision or a harness step.

The model's private text is never included; ``short`` is written by code.
Step.title: Step

helper.description: The helper on the thread's newest routed turn (order, collector, credit, stock, brand, proof or mimi).
helper.title: Helper

helper_name.description: Its display name (Order, Collector, Credit, Stock, Brand, Proof or Mimi).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

status.description: needs_you: a pending approval or a turn waiting on the owner; running: a turn queued or running; done: otherwise.
status.title: Status

title.description: A short title written by code (never shop text).
title.title: Title

TurnIn.description: One inbound message from a shop, a rep or the owner.

message_id.description: The channel's own message id (WhatsApp wamid, console id). The same id twice is one turn.
message_id.title: Message Id

phone.description: The sender's number as the channel gave it. Empty for the owner in the console.
phone.title: Phone

received_at.description: When the message was received, with its zone. Defaults to now. A time without a zone is read as Africa/Lagos (WAT, UTC+1).
received_at.title: Received At

tenant_id.description: Optional; must match the bearer key's distributor.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

TurnIn.title: TurnIn

run_id.description: The harness run id: the trace id in Langfuse.
run_id.title: Run Id

VoiceReply.description:
The reply's own text, read aloud (RAI-290): fetch the audio from
``GET /v1/messages/{message_id}/voice`` and send it after the text.
VoiceReply.title: VoiceReply

info.description: The live Mimi agent for the distributor console and the WhatsApp webhook. Mimi proposes, code checks, the owner approves; nothing moves money. Demo data is synthetic; model calls are real.
info.title: Mimi agent API

get.description:
For the platform's probe: the process is up and serving. Readiness,
with the database and queue, is ``GET /v1/health``.

post.description:
A fresh copy of the synthetic Coral Lane Trading world and a token
for it (send it as ``Authorization: Bearer``). 404 in live mode.
post.summary: Demo mode: start a session on a fresh synthetic copy

post.description:
Queues the event as a turn on the shop's thread (or the job thread).

The words the helper sees are written here from the event's kind and
shop, never taken from the caller: a system event carries no free text.
post.summary: Send one system event (a Go webhook or a routine) to Mimi

get.summary: The caller's distributor, role and mode

get.description:
The reply's text, read aloud: made now, never stored. 404 when the
reply has no voice note (flag off, the shop did not opt in or did not
send a voice note, or the code check on the figures failed). The text
reply always goes too.

200.description: The voice note for this reply
